core.detail: LanguageServerAdapter is the single host-owned boundary: openDocument/changeDocument/closeDocument/pullDiagnostics/navigate/rename/dispose with negotiated RangeEncoding and host-owned document versions + digests. StdioLspAdapter implements real JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio with Content-Length framing, initialize/initialized, didOpen/didChange/didClose, textDocument/diagnostic pull, bounded navigation methods, rename, shutdown/exit. No method is assumed on the Hermes engine.

languageServerDescriptor resolves only installed approved executables (typescript-language-server for TS/JS, pyright-langserver for Python) via fixed where/command -v lookup; no auto-download, no project plug-ins. An absent approved server fails UNSUPPORTED — never a regex or unrestricted-shell fallback.

LanguageServerPool keys by physical workspace root + language + executable/config digest + execution profile; shares startup through a pending map, invalidates on owner/root/config change, reaps idle servers after 5 minutes and disposes all owned resources on profile revocation.

Eligible writes debounce 100 ms per document; inline observations get a 250 ms budget, delayed ones 5 s; a timeout returns state UNAVAILABLE without undoing the successful edit. Every observation binds workspaceIdentity, serverIdentity, documentVersion, beforeDigest and afterDigest; markStale reports STALE when the document moved on.

diffDiagnostics separates introduced from existing only when the before/after comparison is valid (matching beforeDigest and a CURRENT prior observation). baselineStatus UNAVAILABLE reports 'Baseline unavailable' — existing errors are never labelled new.

definition/references/implementation/hover go through bounded reads. Positions convert between negotiated UTF8/UTF16/UTF32 encodings — byte offsets never equal UTF-16 positions; mid-surrogate offsets clamp to boundaries. Result file URIs are refused unless inside a current granted root; results cap at 100 with an explicit truncation marker.

EditPreviewRegistry keeps at most 8 open previews per run and 256 KiB aggregate; frames are inert text — partial arguments produce no target and no frame authorizes a write. seal() binds exact before/proposed digests; validateFinal rejects a changed final-arguments digest as INVALID; settle records APPLIED or CONFLICT; cancellation discards the preview.

locateAnchor treats anchors/hashlines as locators only: zero or repeated matches are rejected instead of fuzzy-rewriting arbitrary code; verifyEditPreimage compares the sha256 of current bytes to the expected preimage digest.

planRename rejects documentChanges resource operations (create/rename/delete), unsupported change shapes and any URI outside granted roots; binds sourceVersions and expectedBeforeDigests per target. applyRename requires the exact approval id, validates every preimage under the workspace mutation lock before the first change, writes the durable journal plus per-file backups before the first change, and flushes the journal per file. recoverRename reconciles each path independently: restores a path only when current bytes match the written postimage, reports Unchanged/Applied honestly, and stops at PARTIAL_RECOVERY_REQUIRED on external edits — never a silent overwrite, backups retained.

DebugRegistry launches only through selectBackend on the approved backend with a PASS platform proof; inspect (threads/stackTrace/scopes/variables) is a bounded read requiring a paused session; launch/continue/step/evaluate are effectful commands that can execute code; stack frames and variables cap at 100 each and values clamp at 4 KiB; revoke terminates all owned sessions and reports teardown failures rather than pretending they are gone.

Exactly coding.intelligenceV1, coding.renameV1, coding.debuggerV1 added to HOST_FLAG_REGISTRY, all default false, enabled only via HARNESS_FLAG_* env with value 1/true. The secret-custody registry assertion was updated from three to six keys; strict UI preferences still reject every flag key.

integration.detail: apps/server/code-intelligence-routes.ts registers flag-gated POST endpoints beneath the existing authenticated hooks (diagnostics, navigate, previews, rename plan/apply/recover, debug launch/inspect/effect/terminate), admitted through projects.binding for exact project path + workspace identity, with zod-validated bodies, no-store headers and AbortSignals. Registered in server.ts.

CodeIntelligencePanel renders Problems grouped as introduced / existing (no baseline) / stale with rows opening an exact file range; streamed previews carry a persistent 'Not applied' badge while STREAMING_UNAPPLIED or READY_UNAPPLIED and INVALID/CONFLICT states; rename results show per-file Applied/Restored/Unchanged/Conflict; debug controls separate Inspect from Run/Continue/Step with disabled commands explaining the missing approval/confinement. Wired into the cr-context aside via an optional codeIntelligence prop — absent when host flags are off.

Completed diagnostics observations feed as CheckObservationV1 records with observationKind 'review-advisory' through the new public recordAdvisory on ProjectVerificationService — the same append-only checkObservation bucket task_finish completionAssessment and the verification panel read. Debug launch/inspect/effect/terminate commands feed the same way. Advisory digests bind honestly: codeDigest is the observed document digest, dependencyDigest the language-server executable digest, recipeDigest a deterministic digest of the advisory tool descriptor. verification-gate.computeAssessment treats a review-advisory PASS like an audit marker — it informs review but can never satisfy a declared requirement, while advisory FAIL/BLOCKED/CANCELLED outcomes still count against completion. The feed is silent while verification.workflowV1 is off and asserts the flag on write.

packages/runtime-hermes/worker.py carries only write-hook status (applied/failed/stale/disabled/...); no diagnostics bridge exists there yet. The host adapter boundary and observe() contract are ready for that feed; wiring the worker's bind_completed_writes hook to call intelligence.observe remains open.
